faq.faq1Question: Is Learn English free to use?
faq.faq1Answer: You can browse courses and enroll in free lessons at no cost. Some premium courses are paid and can be purchased individually.
faq.faq2Question: How does the point and leaderboard system work?
faq.faq2Answer: Each set of 10 words gives +10 points for a correct answer and -2 for a wrong one. Your accumulated score decides your position on that course's leaderboard.
faq.faq3Question: Can I switch courses after enrolling?
faq.faq3Answer: Yes. You can enroll in as many courses as you like and switch between them freely from your course list.
faq.faq4Answer: Paid courses can be purchased using your in-app wallet or supported payment partners such as MoMo.
faq.faq5Question: Do you offer a mobile app?
faq.faq5Answer: Not yet — the platform is fully responsive and works well in your mobile browser in the meantime.

aboutPage.heroDescription: We're building a smarter way to learn English — combining focused vocabulary practice, real-life listening and speaking exercises, and a motivating leaderboard to help learners stay consistent.
aboutPage.storyDescription: Learn English started from a simple observation: most learners don't fail from a lack of resources, but from a lack of consistency. So we built a platform centered on short, scored practice sessions that make showing up every day feel rewarding — not overwhelming.

value.learnerFirstDescription: Every feature we build starts from a real learning problem, not a trend.
value.qualityDescription: Courses are organized around real exam topics like TOEIC, IELTS and VSTEP.
value.communityDescription: Thousands of learners practice together and motivate each other daily.
